llama_3_2_1b.source: Llama-3.2-1B config: hidden 2048, intermediate 8192, 32 q heads, 8 kv heads, head dim 64; fused qkv and gate-up as served

egress.source: DitherInstance.lean (Security/Definitions/Pouw/Guarantees): an exchanged bit replaces at most beta = n_max W_mac of priced work (OutsourceWithinEgress), W_mac counting the block's hashing, caps set at served traffic, and 'without a streamed side about 1 kbit carries a whole sampling block'; ssn_1l_hw's coins S + 15 bits a row in whole words (N-PREM interim, compute-research/20261029T0740Z-report-np-prem); credited hashing 232.0 W1 units a MAC at HASH-38's bar for ssn-1l/served/s8/k32/w/r256k/cert/min (pouw_space.py, run r20261029-081541-bf69), so 0.1307 B a MAC; caps: a 4-byte token id in or out a token row, and 10x that for text and framing (estimates); the seeded lead's window salt is 512 bits (pouw.salt)

space_t2.source: pouw_space.py and pouw_space.toml at N-CARD's 2558e9ecaf (cursor/compute-research-np-card-7c2d) with --add alt_roads_cards.toml, the async engine's honest step t_H, stock's step and A's root chain before each call's noise (an estimate nobody has timed) for R1b's top designs (run r20261029-081541-bf69); 64 serial calls a Llama-3.2-1B forward (16 layers x qkv, o, gate-up, down); round trips 2 us (RDMA) to 10 us

links.source: benchmarks/census/networks.json dc-1ms-100gbps (reference); 400 Gb/s a GPU is an HGX H200's compute-fabric NIC (sensitivity, not a census entry); NVLink 4 (900 GB/s a Hopper GPU) and NVLink 5 (1.8 TB/s a Blackwell GPU) are a what-if for an NVLink domain that spans machines, which an HGX H200 doesn't have; PCIe Gen5 x16 device-to-host into pinned host memory (min-max of 3 x 8 GiB) and int8 cuBLAS GEMMs' slowdown under a concurrent device-to-host stream that outlasts them (min-max over 5 Llama and square shapes), alt_roads_egress.sh on one H200 at 1980 MHz (run r20261029-080123-0158, art:33b1cc829b8f2735773529db549d0ecde8b6cfd090001d793eff2db40f5be898)
